heading: The Minimum Payment Trap
sub: A 29 second vertical short, cut to 128 bpm. Below: the rendered video with a voice, six voices to choose from, a live preview, a hook lab, and questions for you.
aria: Vertical animated short: Mei pays the minimum on her card and debt barely drops, an X-ray shows most of the payment feeds interest, then adding twenty dollars a month clears the debt years sooner.
body:
The rendered video, with a voice

Mei's voice is Google Gemini text-to-speech (voice: Leda). Every line only repeats what is already on screen, so the video still works muted. This is the real file, rendered frame by frame (720p copy; the 1080x1920 master stays on your computer).

The same video without a voice:

Mei's voice: Leda

I chose the voice with a blind test: eight voices read the same three lines, two audio-capable models scored them without seeing the names, and Leda won. A model is a screening tool, not your ear, so here are the top three reading the same lines. The voiced video above uses Leda.

Leda8.5 of 10: my pick: lively, clear numbers, only voice in both judges' top two
Callirrhoe7.9 of 10: runner-up: natural, but one judge heard an older, teacher-like tone
Laomedeia7.5 of 10: third: dry and natural, but one judge heard it as flat

Hook lab

The first two seconds decide everything, so the show tests three openings for every episode. Tap one and watch the first moments.
